description.narrative: The project, Developing MRV System and National Capacity towards the Enhanced Transparency Framework (ETF) for the United Republic of Tanzania (MRV4Tanzania), seeks to strengthen the institutional and technical foundations required for Tanzania to meet its obligations under the Paris Agreement and to effectively participate in emerging carbon market opportunities. The project responds to the establishment of the National Carbon Monitoring Centre (NCMC) under the Environmental Management Act (Cap. 191), which has been mandated to coordinate greenhouse gas management, establish national monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) systems, register carbon projects, and oversee carbon trading activities in Tanzania. Funded by the Royal Norwegian Embassy and implemented by UNDP as Agreement Partner, the project will provide one year of inception support to strengthen NCMCs institutional, operational, fiduciary, and technological readiness. The project will support the establishment of core financial management, human resource, procurement, and partnership management systems; refine the scope and priorities of the proposed MRV4Tanzania programme; strengthen stakeholder coordination and private sector engagement; and assess technology requirements needed to support climate transparency and carbon market functions, contributing to the development of a national carbon registry.
